principle: Community vocabulary may name useful derived functional parents, but no community label overrides Oracle/CR-grounded mechanical truth.

entries.working_scope: mana acceleration above ordinary on-curve production
entries.boundary: Do not encode one-shot rituals as universally inside or outside the term. Preserve temporary-versus-repeatable acceleration as a separate coordinate and expose the naming dispute.

entries.working_scope: creature that provides mana, usually through a mana ability
entries.boundary: Creature body, summoning-sickness exposure, quantity, colors, and conditionality remain mechanical coordinates.

entries.working_scope: artifact used as repeatable mana acceleration or fixing
entries.boundary: Do not infer identical speed, net acceleration, color access, or durability from the label.

entries.working_scope: mana acceleration whose immediate output is unusually efficient relative to its setup cost
entries.boundary: Exact efficiency boundary is community-dependent; keep as strategic/functional vocabulary, not a direct fact.

entries.working_scope: one-shot spell/effect that produces a burst of mana
entries.boundary: Whether ritual is a child of ramp is vocabulary-dependent; the temporary resource pattern itself is objective.

entries.working_scope: effect used to clear a broad section of the battlefield or reset an opposing board
entries.boundary: May be symmetric/asymmetric and may destroy, exile, bounce, shrink, sacrifice, or otherwise clear. Scope and persistence must remain explicit.

entries.working_scope: colloquial subfamily of creature-board wipes, historically anchored to Wrath of God
entries.boundary: Do not assume destroy specifically; current usage may include non-destroy sweepers.

entries.working_scope: interaction whose job is to neutralize an opposing object or threat
entries.boundary: Object class, target requirement, destination, permanence, compensation, timing, and scope are necessary child coordinates.

entries.working_scope: cards/effects used to disrupt, answer, constrain, or respond to opponents' game actions or threats
entries.boundary: Too broad for a canonical mechanical predicate. Useful as an upper functional parent only.

entries.working_scope: effects used to preserve a player, board, permanent, spell, or game plan through opposing interaction
entries.boundary: Do not confuse the strategic role with the rules keyword protection. Hexproof, indestructible, phasing, counter-protection, recursion, and interaction suppression have different failure modes.

entries.working_scope: effects whose job is to deny or reduce opponents' graveyard resources or graveyard-based lines
entries.boundary: Persistent prevention/replacement, one-shot exile, targeted exile, and access locks are different child mechanisms with different coverage.

entries.working_scope: strategic family of effects that materially constrain opponents' ability to execute game actions or resources
entries.boundary: Boundary with tax, prison, hatebear, and control is unstable. Never materialize as direct mechanical truth.

entries.working_scope: small/efficient creature whose static or triggered effect constrains a class of opposing game actions
entries.boundary: Creature size/cost threshold and exact strategic boundary vary; mechanical restriction remains separately represented.

entries.working_scope: cheap effect that replaces itself by drawing a card while performing another small job or selection action
entries.boundary: Exact mana-value ceiling is not stable. A single self-replacement is not by itself net card advantage.

entries.working_scope: repeatable or readily available way to sacrifice one's own permanent(s), commonly creatures, as enabling infrastructure
entries.boundary: Free versus paid, once-per-turn versus repeatable, object scope, activation timing, and payoff/output are separate coordinates.

entries.working_scope: search/select from library for one or more cards under specified restrictions
entries.boundary: Destination is job-defining: hand, battlefield, graveyard, top of library, exile, and reveal-only searches must not collapse.

entries.working_scope: strategy/role family built around moving valuable creatures or permanents from graveyard to battlefield
entries.boundary: Entomb-style setup and Reanimate-style payoff may be functionally adjacent in a reanimator deck while remaining different context-free jobs.

entries.working_scope: net increase in usable cards/resources relative to expenditure
entries.boundary: Keep separate from card selection, filtering, and velocity. Exact resource-accounting conventions vary by context.

entries.working_scope: ability to see or cycle through more cards without necessarily creating net card advantage
entries.boundary: Do not use as a synonym for draw count; selection depth, retain count, discard/exile/bottom disposition, and repeatability matter.

entries.working_scope: functional parent for effects whose job is to protect a proactive turn/line by denying or making opposing interaction impractical during that turn
entries.boundary: Children include hard action prohibition and out-of-turn spell taxation. This is a proposed functional coordinate, not community terminology or canonical truth.

entries.working_scope: functional parent for effects that inspect a meaningful top-of-library window and retain a chosen subset as accessible cards
entries.boundary: Selection depth, retained quantity, payment, timing, and disposition of rejected cards remain required coordinates.
